name: Domain of Forsaken Ruins
description: Many of those who come here now do so solely to search for nearby treasure. Just as crowds naturally leave a theater after the curtain falls, this once thriving colony has now been reduced to all but empty remains.

tabs.name: Explore: Lucky Encounter in the Clouds
tabs.description: Only by a stroke of luck may one chance upon this paradise enveloped by clouds and mist. Though it appears serene from the outside, there is peril to be found within.
